title: In the AFTER screenshot the two units at Back-Alley Bar (Unsung Hero and the just-played Ravenbloom Student) are rendered as tiny thumbnails overflowing the bottom-right of the battlefield panel and clipped so only the top ~20px strip is visible; the newly played unit is essentially invisible/unidentifiable on the board.
expected: Screenshot 28.png (zoomed) confirms: Back-Alley Bar's player-side unit row shows Unsung Hero + the exhausted Ravenbloom Student clipped to a ~25px top strip at the bottom-right of the panel. Source cause: gameplay.css:1143-1158 `.bf-units { flex: 1 1 56px; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; }` splits the .bf-body height equally between the (empty) opponent-side and player-side rows, while `.bf-units .card` is fixed at 90x126px (gameplay.css:490-494) and `.battlefield { overflow: hidden }` (gameplay.css:927) inside a `.battlefield-row` of min-height 180px (gameplay.css:119). At the 1920x1080 logical layout each .bf-units row gets ~45px for a 126px card, so the unit is clipped/scrolled out of view by default; board.js:137-139 renders playerUnits into that container with no size adaptation. Public battlefield state is effectively hidden right after the play.
